About Courage

Care rooted
in community.

Established in 2023 in Kollieta Wolah, Courage Medical & Rehab Center serves Gbarnga and surrounding communities in Bong County, Central Liberia.

Our mission

To provide high-quality, compassionate healthcare to all individuals, regardless of their economic status.

Our vision

A healthy community where everyone has access to the medical care they need to live fulfilling lives.

Patient-centered care

We value the contribution of our patients and work with them to develop care that reflects their needs and goals.

Respect and compassion

We aim to offer friendly, caring support that respects the dignity and values of every patient.

Knowledge and connection

Patient education and relationships with our community are central to our approach.

Facilities & technology

Supporting informed care.

On-site laboratory

Diagnostic testing supports the center’s medical services.

Butterfly IQ3 imaging

The center’s documented imaging equipment supports diagnosis and treatment.
